trigger_condition.shape_trigger: Small logical shape with caller-provided custom size list
trigger_condition.memory_trigger: Small backing storage; custom stride values exceed allocated storage bounds
trigger_condition.value_trigger: Stride values cause logical source elements to point outside valid storage
trigger_condition.execution_trigger: Direct invocation of aten::_reshape_alias_copy with caller-provided size and stride on a tensor with insufficient storage; copy kernel materializes invalid layout
trigger_condition.concrete_constraints: Example: int64 tensor with 8-element storage, requested size [2] and stride [8]; more generally, size/stride metadata whose computed extents exceed allocated storage.

root_cause.api_layer: aten::_reshape_alias_copy accepts caller-provided size and stride metadata without validating source storage bounds
root_cause.aten_layer: Source tensor geometry is constructed from caller-provided size and stride values before copy
root_cause.kernel_layer: Copy kernel reads from addresses derived from invalid geometry, causing out-of-bounds access

bug_oracle.description: AddressSanitizer reports a heap-buffer-overflow read during materialization of the invalid layout; the invalid read occurs outside the source tensor storage.

harness_strategy.input_mutation: Mutate size and stride metadata, including large stride values, sparse layouts, zero or negative strides, and size/stride mismatches
harness_strategy.tensor_construction: Construct small CPU tensors with minimal backing storage, preferably integer dtypes such as int64
harness_strategy.constraint_injection: Inject invalid size/stride combinations whose computed logical extents exceed allocated storage
harness_strategy.operation_sequence: Call aten::_reshape_alias_copy or similar stride-accepting reshape/alias copy operators directly with crafted tensor and metadata, then force materialization
harness_strategy.oracle_construction: Run under AddressSanitizer or a similar memory checker; detect heap-buffer-overflow, invalid reads, or process crashes
